name: Choppies Enterprises Limited
source: Choppies Enterprises Limited summarised audited group financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income (BSE disclosure 7247 and JSE SENS 18 September 2026, audited by Forvis Mazars with an unqualified opinion). Figures stated in Pula millions in the filing and stored here in BWP. Retail sales 9,822 less cost of sales 7,806 equals gross profit 2,016, the file basis which uses retail sales as revenue. Operating expenses 1,773 are the printed expenditure of 1,840 less the 67 other operating income, which reconciles to operating profit before interest of 243. Finance costs 113 less finance income 1 gives net finance costs of 112. Profit before taxation 131 less taxation 57 equals 74 profit from continuing operations, and 75 attributable to the owners of the parent, the basis of the printed 4.1 thebe basic and headline earnings per share. A 1 million non-controlling interest loss separates the two. Group revenue including other income was 9,889. Earlier columns are the Yahoo Finance basis and store the same attributable bottom line.
